hints.title: Lazy Flip Flag
hints.text: Maintain a boolean flag to track whether the bitset is currently inverted, enabling flip in constant time.

hints.title: Interpret True Bit Value
hints.text: A position stores 1 if (arr[idx] ^ flipped) is 1, otherwise it represents 0.

hints.title: Track Set Bit Count
hints.text: Keep a running count of 1s. On flip, the new count becomes size minus the old count.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(1) for fix, unfix, flip, all, one, count; O(N) for toString
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Flipping all bits element-by-element takes O(N) time per flip, leading to time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A boolean inversion flag reduces flip from O(N) to O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement lazy bit inversion with running count maintenance.
